definitions.gloss: to hit, to strike, to beat
definitions.explanation: To strike something with force using a hand, tool, or object. Physical impact.
To type on a keyboard or input data. Modern usage derived from the physical striking motion.
To play instruments that are struck (drums, piano) or hit (golf, baseball).

examples.japanese: キーボードを{打|う}つのが{速|はや}い。
{彼|かれ}はホームランを{打|う}った。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{打|う}つ (hit/strike X). Related intransitive forms exist for specific meanings.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or repeated action. {打|う}っている = 'is hitting/typing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{太鼓|たいこ}を{打|う}つ (beat a drum)
・キーボードを{打|う}つ (type on keyboard)
・ボールを{打|う}つ (hit a ball)
・{注射|ちゅうしゃ}を{打|う}つ (give an injection)
・{電報|でんぽう}を{打|う}つ (send a telegram—older usage)
・{手|て}を{打|う}つ (take measures; clap hands)

SPECIAL EXPRESSIONS:
・{心|こころ}を{打|う}つ (to move/touch someone's heart)
・{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ (meeting, prior arrangement—noun)

HOMOPHONES: Don't confuse with {撃|う}つ (to shoot), {討|う}つ (to attack/defeat), or {鬱|うつ} (depression). These are different kanji with different meanings.
